title: אזור ארמונות החורף ביריחו (תולול אבו אל־עלייק) - 1982-1978 (Jericho, winter palaces)
author: E. Netzer
location_note: Tulul Abu el-ʿAlayiq, both banks of Wadi Qelt at the west of the Jericho plain; no map reference.
notes: Hasmonean royal estate (farm) and palaces, Herod's second and third palaces, industrial area F. Earlier seasons were reported in earlier HA volumes.

features.subtype: Wadi Qelt and Naʿaran aqueducts (meeting point, bridge, later connecting segments); siphon water systems with clay pipes in Herod's peristyle garden; garden water channels
features.period: Hasmonean (Qelt aqueduct earlier than Naʿaran aqueduct) and Herodian
features.quote: כי אמת המים מואדי קלט קדמה בבניינה לאמת המים מנערן

features.subtype: swimming pools (small 8 x 8 m; the large pool; two in the twin palaces 8 x 8 and 7 x 7 m; a third 20 x 12 m); a courtyard pool 7 x 7 m; a deep pool 3.5 x 4 m ('miqveh?')
features.period: Hasmonean, some in use in the Herodian period

features.subtype: miqvaʾot (excavators' label) in the twin palaces, the bathing complex, the large Hasmonean house (two pools 3 m deep), each of 7-8 large buildings (two pools each), the industrial area and Herod's third palace
features.quote: בכל אחד מן הבניינים נמצאו מקווה טהרה עם שתי

features.subtype: two plastered winepresses on the estate (treading, settling and collecting pools; one with mosaic) and a winepress in the industrial area
features.period: large winepress dated with the Hasmonean farm, probably Alexander Jannaeus
features.quote: נראה כי יש לתארך אותה לתאריך בניין החווה

features.subtype: round tower by the Tariq el-Hindi road used as columbarium and watchtower (plan like the round columbarium at Masada)

title: ראס א־טאוויל, אתר ביזאנטי (Ras et-Tawil, Byzantine site)
author: S. Gibson, A. Kloner
location_note: Summit of Ras et-Tawil south of Neve Yaʿaqov (text); the printed map reference is garbled in the copy and not used.
screen_note: EXPLORATORY ADDITION: heading not in the gazetteer and map reference unreadable; the text places the site south of Neve Yaʿaqov (gazetteer Z4). Read because it fell inside the Jericho-Jerusalem reading span.
notes: Byzantine chapel and farm, Abbasid use; an Iron Age lime kiln on the west slope reported with it.

features.subtype: large cave below the chapel, joined to its floor by a rectangular shaft
features.quote: פיר מלבני בריצפת הקאפלה חיבר בינה לבין מערה גדולה

features.subtype: round installation with a drain covered by stone slabs
features.quote: ומיתקן עגול עם תעלת ניקוז מקורה לוחות

features.subtype: hoard wrapped in cloth: c. 200 Abbasid coins and a bronze ring
features.quote: נתגלה מטמון עטוף בבד שכלל כ־ 200 מטבעות

features.subtype: large winepress with plastered red treading floor and must pit; further rock-cuttings
cistern fed by settling basins

title: ירושלים, הרובע היהודי - 1982-1981 (Jerusalem, Jewish Quarter)
author: N. Avigad
location_note: Cardo and Nea church, Old City; no map reference.
notes: Byzantine Cardo with rock-cut shop spaces (not coded); Nea church apse.

features.subtype: western drain of the Cardo, rock-cut with grooves for cover slabs

title: ירושלים, עיר דוד - 1981 (Jerusalem, City of David - 1981)
author: Y. Shiloh
location_note: City of David; no map reference.
notes: Areas D, E1-E3, G, J. Terraces and walls not eligible. Over 120 Rhodian stamped handles.

features.subtype: structure whose inner walls are built like a 'columbarium' (report's quotation marks)
Warren's Shaft: natural shaft integrated into the Iron Age water system
features.quote: של פיר ו ורן הוא במקורו פיר ,טבעי

title: סקר ארכיאולוגי בצפון־מזרח ירושלים (North-East Jerusalem, Survey)
author: S. Gibson
location_note: c. 10 km2 between French Hill and Neve Yaʿaqov, incl. Tell el-Ful; about 85 sites, some with map references.
notes: Stone-vessel workshop of the 1st c. CE indicated by vessel fragments in the Hizma Muslim cemetery (no installation described; not coded). Lime kilns not coded.

features.subtype: at least c. 60 rock-cut agricultural installations (oil presses, winepresses) and quarries across the survey area
tombs at nine late Iron Age sites
tombs among 21 Hellenistic-period sites
oil press
cisterns of a large settlement

title: ירושלים, סקר ארכיאולוגי ברמות (Jerusalem, Ramot, Survey)
author: R. Arav
location_note: Ramot development areas; sites with map references.
notes: Coins of John Hyrcanus and of the procurators at Ras el-Bad (site finds, not feature dates). Roads, monastery and tumulus not coded.

features.subtype: quarries; two rock-cut winepresses (one round, one square); two caves with an oil press and two rock-cut vats
features.period: site sherds Iron II, Hellenistic, Byzantine

features.subtype: four plastered bell-shaped cisterns
eight caves (two with industrial installations, four with a square room and blocked entrance shaft, two more)
two burial caves with kokhim (one with a Byzantine lamp)
features.quote: נתגלו טלוט מערות :קבורה האחת במידרון המזרחי

features.subtype: burial cave with entrance room and inner room without kokhim (north slope)
features.quote: נראה טזמנה טל מערה זו בתקופת

features.subtype: five cisterns in a walled agricultural unit
industrial pressing installation
tomb cave in secondary use, built entrance and niches
cistern at the foot of the spur
rock-cut winepress and two industrial installations

title: ירושלים, גת ליד ח׳ עין אל־תות (Jerusalem, winepress near Kh. ʿEin et-Tut)
author: Y. Gat
location_note: Near Kh. ʿEin et-Tut (HA 77 map ref 1663/1326); no map reference here.

features.subtype: winepress with central and two side treading floors, must vat lined with mosaic, settling pit, storage system; rock-cut must vat and small plastered pit added later
features.quote: בשלב ראשון היתה זו גת ביזאנטית

title: ירושלים, רמות - קבר מתקופת בית שני (Jerusalem, Ramot, Second Temple tomb)
author: J. Zias

features.subtype: burial chamber with four kokhim and a central pit covered by a slab; nine individuals
features.period: Second Temple period; two juglets of the 1st c. CE
features.quote: הקבר כולל חדר קבורה בעל ארבעה כוכים

features.subtype: two burial caves with square chamber, standing pit and three benches (one with a short kokh and bone pit); ossuary lid fragments
features.period: cut in the Iron Age; both reused at the end of the 2nd c. BCE, one also in the 1st c. BCE
features.quote: שתיהן היו בשימוש נוסף בסוף המאה הבי לפסה״ג

author: A. Kloner, Y. Gat

various water channels
